actions.name: Time Out (Resolution)

cost.trigger: The user used Time Out (Set-Up) as their last Action.

actions.description:
Trigger: The user used Time Out (Set-Up) as their last Action.

Effect: On hit, all legal targets gain @Affliction[suppressed 7], @Affliction[hindered 7], @Affliction[unlucky 7], @Affliction[disabled 7] (decided randomly), and @Affliction[nullified 7] (decided randomly) and are Flinched.

actions.name: Time Out (Set-Up)
actions.description: Effect: The user gains @Affliction[braced 2]. If the user is hit by a Physical or Special-Category Attack before their next Activation, they may use Time Out (Resolution) as a Free Action as a Free Action at [Interrupt 5].
